title: An Artist in the Himalayas
edition_statement: The New York issue (Macmillan & Co., 1895); the London edition is T. Fisher Unwin’s
summary: Arthur David McCormick (1860–1943), an English painter, went as artist with Martin Conway’s expedition of 1892 to the Karakoram. He describes the voyage from London to Karachi, the road through Kashmir by Srinagar to Gilgit, Bagrot, and Hunza and Nagyr, the crossing of the Hispar Pass, and the climb up the Baltoro glacier towards the Golden Throne, when the party reached the summit they named Pioneer Peak; then the return by Askole, Scardu, and Leh to Srinagar. He writes lightly of camp life, porters, the Gurkhas of the party, local rulers, and sketching in snow and wind. The book has over a hundred of the sketches he made on the journey, and a map of Kashmir showing the route.
